title: Glowing tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <!-- big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='18' fill='#1f8f5c'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='13' fill='#37d68a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='6' fill='#a8f5cf'/>
  <!-- rear wheel treads -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='3' fill='#0f6b42'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='88' r='3' fill='#0f6b42'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='70' r='3' fill='#0f6b42'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='70' r='3' fill='#0f6b42'/>
  <!-- small front wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='11' fill='#1f8f5c'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='7' fill='#37d68a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='3' fill='#a8f5cf'/>
  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='40' height='18' rx='4' fill='#ff5a3c'/>
  <!-- body highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='24' y='54' width='36' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff9a7a'/>
  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='24' y='44' width='22' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ffb547'/>
  <!-- hood highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='46' width='18' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='28' y='34' width='3' height='11' rx='1.5' fill='#c0d6f5'/>
  <rect x='27' y='31' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8f3ff'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='50' y='30' width='20' height='24' rx='3' fill='#ff7aa8'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x='54' y='34' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='48' y='26' width='24' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd1e2'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='50' r='3' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='50' r='5' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
